summary: GrowHub Ltd files Form 6-K disclosing Nasdaq's determination to delist its securities due to failure to meet minimum bid price and stockholders' equity requirements, followed by a hearing and subsequent grant of an exception conditioned on completing a merger. On July 14, 2026, the company entered into a merger agreement with EnChem America, whereby Merger Sub will merge into the Target, with Target Shareholders receiving 142,848,176 Class A shares (85% of fully-diluted shares), constituting a change in control. The exception requires demonstrating compliance with initial listing standards by December 2, 2026. What to watch: completion of the reverse merger and Nasdaq compliance.
